title: Where Will the 2027 Total Solar Eclipse Last Over Six Minutes?
description:
Where Will the 2027 Total Solar Eclipse Last Over Six Minutes?

On 2 August 2027, the Moon's umbral shadow—up to 258 kilometres wide—will sweep across southern Spain, North Africa, and Egypt, turning midday into night for up to 6 minutes and 23 seconds.

Sources: NASA Goddard Space Flight Center Eclipse Predictions by Fred Espenak (2027 Aug 02 Total Solar Eclipse; greatest duration 06m23.2s; path width up to 258 km across Spain, Morocco, Algeria, Tunisia, Libya, Egypt, Saudi Arabia; 2026 Aug 12 total eclipse 02m18s).
https://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/SEgoogle/SEgoogle2001/SE2027Aug02Tgoogle.html
https://eclipse.gsfc.nasa.gov/SEdecade/SEdecade2021.html

Pictures: NASA and NOAA imagery alongside our own animated graphics. Facts: every number is checked against the sources above.
Image credits: NASA; NOAA; ESO.
